links.outcome: Readability and grade-level demand of chatbot responses about dental implant failure
links.effect: Readability and linguistic complexity varied markedly across the four chatbots; DeepSeek-R1 offered the best readability. No numeric reading-level values are reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Although CLEAR and mGQS scores were high across all systems, readability and linguistic complexity varied markedly.

screen.reason: Compares performance (accuracy, readability, quality) of four off-the-shelf LLMs on patient questions regarding dental implant failure without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
